description: This file defines the 'ArticleTag' class, which models the association between articles and tags within the domain layer of the application.

classes.name: ArticleTag
classes.description: Represents the link between an article and a tag, containing references to both and their identifiers.

properties.name: ArticleId
properties.description: The unique identifier for the associated article.

properties.name: Article
properties.description: Nullable reference to the associated Article object.

properties.name: TagId
properties.description: Nullable identifier for the associated Tag.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: Nullable reference to the associated Tag object.
